thread.title: Apple Inc ( AAPL ) closed Wednesday at $167.43, slipping by

author: Richard Suttmeier
title: Apple Inc ( AAPL ) closed Wednesday at $167.43, slipping by
text:
Apple Inc ( AAPL ) closed Wednesday at $167.43, slipping by 1.1% year to date, but solidly in bull market territory 31.8% above its 52-week low of $127.1 set on Feb. 1, 2017. The stock was 7% below its all-time intraday high of $180.10 set on Jan. 18. A negative reaction to earnings could put Apple into correction territory. Today’s close will thus be important.
Analysts expected Apple to earn between $3.81 and $3.94 a share and the report was $3.89, toward the upper end of the range. Some say that despite this beat, iPhone unit sales lagged, and guidance was below expectations, but don’t worry about the company long-term. This is the why the stock traded within the bonds of my key levels in after-hours on Thursday.
The daily chart for Apple Courtesy of MetaStock Xenith 
The daily chart shows that Apple has been above a ‘golden cross’ since Sept. 6, 2016 when the stock closed at $107.70. A ‘golden cross’ occurs when the 50-day simple moving average rises above the 200-day simple moving average indicating that higher prices lie ahead.
The horizontal lines on the chart were clearly important following earnings. The key level to hold is my quarterly value level of $164.46, and the after-hours low was $165.38. A break below $164.46 puts the focus on the 200-day simple moving average of $159.37. Apple was not able to stay above my annual pivot of $176.57 between Jan. 12 and Jan. 24, but the after-hours high was between my semiannual pivot of $170.50 and my annual pivot of $176.57, but no new high.
